params.name: LOOP
params.desc: see chapter 4.9.

params.name: LSPCH
params.desc: if false, space charge fields are not taken into account.

params.name: LSPCH3D
params.desc: if true space 3D charge fields are calculated with an FFT algorithm, if false the standard calculation on a cylindrical grid is used, see chapter 4.5.

params.name: L2D_3D
params.desc: if true a transition of 2D to 3D space charge calculation is made at position z_trans. See chapter 4.6.

params.name: Lmirror
params.desc: if true, mirror charges at the cathode are taken into account. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.4.

params.name: L_Curved_Cathode
params.desc: if true, the mirror charge will be corrected for a non-planar cathode. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.5.

params.name: Cathode_Contour
params.desc: file name of the table describing the cathode contour.

params.name: R_zero
params.desc: on-axis curvature of a curved cathode.

params.name: Nrad
params.desc: number of grid cells in radial direction up to the bunch radius. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm.

params.name: Cell_var
params.desc: variation of the cell height in radial direction. The innermost cell is cell_var times higher than the outermost cell. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm.

params.name: Nlong_in
params.desc: maximum number of grid cells in longitudinal direction within the bunch length. During the emission process the number is reduced, according to the specification of the minimum cell length min_grid. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm.

params.name: N_min
params.desc: average number of particles to be emitted in one step during the emission from a cathode. N_min is needed to set H_min automatically during emission. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm.

params.name: Merge_1()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Merge_2()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Merge_3()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Merge_4()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Merge_5()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Merge_6()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Merge_7()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Merge_8()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Merge_9()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Merge_10()
params.desc: parameter to merge longitudinal cells. Only for cylindrical grid algorithm, see section 4.4.2.

params.name: Smooth_y
params.desc: smoothing parameter for y-direction. Only for 3D FFT algorithm.

params.name: Smooth_z
params.desc: smoothing parameter for z-direction. Only for 3D FFT algorithm.

params.name: Max_scale
params.desc: if one of the space charge scaling factors exceeds the limit 1± max_scale a new space charge calculation is initiated.

params.name: Max_count
params.desc: if the space charge field has been scaled max_count times a new space charge calculation is initiated.

params.name: Exp_control
params.desc: specifies the maximum tolerable variation of the bunch extensions relative to the gird cell size within one time step (see section 4.4.6).
